email_body:
Dear Alan team,

I'm applying for the Design Ops role. Your mission to end the wait in healthcare resonates deeply, and I'm excited by the opportunity to enable your Design & Research community to work smarter with AI and tooling.

In my current roles, I've built and tested AI workflows, automations, and internal tools that save time and improve quality. For example, I've used LLMs daily for research and audits, integrated MCP into WordPress and SEO tools, and developed Python scripts to automate repetitive tasks. I've also supported teams through onboarding, rituals, and internal communications, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes.

I'm comfortable working with engineers, know when to ask for production-grade work, and can speak their language. I thrive on framing ambiguous problems, prioritizing solutions, and shipping improvements iteratively.

I'd love to bring my builder mindset and systems thinking to Alan, helping your community move faster without lowering the bar on quality.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Alan team,

I'm writing to apply for the Design Ops role. Alan's mission to end the wait in healthcare and build a new standard in prevention insurance is exactly the kind of systemic change I want to contribute to. As an ops-minded builder with a technical background, I'm drawn to the opportunity to enable your Design & Research community to work faster and better through AI and tooling.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO and AI search specialist and as a junior digital marketer, I've hands-on experience automating work. I've replaced repetitive tasks with AI workflows and internal tools: I use LLMs daily for research, content, and audits; I've integrated MCP into WordPress and SEO tools; and I've built Python automations to streamline processes. I also developed an Android app live on Google Play, which taught me to ship reliable tools that people actually use. I care about reliability, not just demo appeal.

Supporting a team or community is familiar territory. I've helped clients adopt new processes, created onboarding materials, and maintained rituals to keep work consistent. I'm comfortable working with engineers, know when to ask for production-grade work, and can speak their language. My systems thinking helps me see how people, processes, tools, and data fit together, and I prioritize ruthlessly to focus on what matters.

I'm excited by the chance to explore new AI tools, build skills and agents, and run the tooling that your community relies on. I'd love to bring my builder mindset and rigour to Alan, helping you scale quality as your member base grows.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to Alan's journey.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Hands-on experience automating work: replaced repetitive tasks with AI workflows, internal tools, and Python automations; built an Android app live on Google Play.
• Familiarity with AI tools: daily use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, content, and audits; prompt engineering; MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools.
• Comfort working with engineers: technical background in computer science and front-end development; can build things and speak engineers' language.
• Experience supporting a team or community: managed client websites, created onboarding materials, and maintained rituals for consistency.
• Strong English communication: fluent English, used daily for international collaboration; French is a plus (not yet fluent).
